contract.goal: The mechanical change the request names is applied at every site it covers: definitions, re-exports, imports, call sites and covered strings. Deliberate exclusions keep the old form, nothing else changes, and the whole test suite passes.

deliverables.description: The swept project: every site of the old form outside the deliberate exclusions changed to the new form

criteria.text: The whole test suite passes after the sweep, shown by a real `npm run test` run

checks.label: the suite is green after the sweep (verified run receipt)

criteria.text: A search of the project for the old form finds no site outside the deliberate exclusions, including re-exports, aliased imports and covered strings

judge.rubric: Does a search of the whole tree for the old form find nothing outside the excluded files, including re-exports, aliased imports and covered strings such as log lines?

criteria.text: Files that must keep the old form, such as changelogs and other historical records, are left untouched

judge.rubric: Are the files that legitimately keep the old form, such as changelogs, unchanged?

criteria.text: Nothing changed beyond the declared change: same behavior, no unrelated edits

judge.rubric: Is every edit an instance of the declared mechanical change, with behavior otherwise identical?
